notes.title: Local game!
notes.content:
A little update. The basis is a local game.
The following changes have been made:
[list]
[*] Local game with two people on the same computer
[*] Joysticks work
[*] Narrative comic at the end of the first boss.
[*] Changed tutorial level 
[*] The balance of the first boss has been changed.
[*] You can choose which boss you want to play as.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo - Release
notes.content:
Defeat the boss fat rat that is lodged in an abandoned tavern.
This is where the adventure begins! Do you have the skills to do it?

Don't forget to take the survey, we really care about your impressions of the game!
